products.title: Jakob Oak 2 Drawer Grooved Coffee Table

description.plain:
• Retro style rectangular coffee table will make a great addition to the living room
  • Crafted from durable rubberwood & oak effect veneer
  • Classic fluted design that adds texture
  • Oak effect finish designed to fit in with a wide range of interior design styles, from traditional to contemporary
  • Convenient storage space by way of 2 wide drawers
  • Sleek black metal handles
  • Scandi-style soft wooden legs
  • Wooden drawer runners
  • Delivery Info

Fill your home with furniture that catches the eye but also keeps your space feeling relaxed and uncluttered. The Jakob Oak 2 Drawer Coffee Table features a beautifully fluted/grooved front that subtly brings more intrigue to a room, along with its' convenient storage space.

Our Jakob furniture collection, which combines mid-century contemporary style with a Nordic design, exudes effortless elegance. This collection, which is made from rubberwood, oak effect veneers, and manufactured wood, gives a modern-retro design that will give your home a timeless vibe.

Additional Dimensions:

  • Drawers: (H) 6.5cm | (W) 37.5cm | (D) 32.5cm
  • Leg height: 26cm

Finished in a stunning oak effect, the Jakob is ideal for anyone who desires the appearance and feel of real oak furniture without the high cost and upkeep needs. To create a slight contrast, sleek black metal handles produce an on-trend, statement finish.

media.alt_text: Jakob coffee table from Roseland Furniture

unique_selling_points: Combines classic fluted design with modern storage in a durable oak effect veneer construction.
top_features: Two spacious drawers provide convenient storage for living room essentials
Classic fluted grooved front adds visual interest and texture
Durable rubberwood oak effect veneer ensures long-lasting quality
Scandi-style soft wooden legs and sleek black metal handles offer modern elegance
Rectangular shape fits a wide range of interior design styles

products.title: Maru Round Oak Pedestal Coffee Table, Silver Oak

description.plain:
DESCRIPTION
  • The Maru Coffee Table boasts contemporary Japandi style with pedestal fluted base made from solid oak.
  • Crafted from solid oak veneer in silver oak colour finish, each table has its unique natural grains and knots.
  • Size: W 80 x D 80 x H 40 cm.
  • Flat packed, simple assembly required.
  • Complete the look: Pictured with our Maru Round Pedestal Coffee Table is our Aurora Hand Braided Cream Jute Rug and Granvia 1-Seater Armless Modular Sofa in Ecru Boucle
DETAILS & DIMENSIONS
    • Size: W 80 x D 80 x H 40 cm
    • Item weight: 14.7 kg.
    • Material:
    • Table top: 18mm solid oak veneer
    • Base: solid oak
    • Care instructions: Wipe clean with a soft cloth. Do not use chemical based abrasive cleaning materials.
    • Assembly Required: Yes.

Sku: BSD-138-SILK

PACKAGE & SHIPPING
    • Package size:
    • Box 1: 91 x 91 x 10.5 cm, 17.5 kg
